lic.snd.title: Sounds and graphics
lic.snd.text: All app sounds (metronome, piano, drone, pads, clicks) are synthesized in real time and use no third-party recordings; tabs use the SONiVOX bank listed above. Icons and illustrations were drawn for the app. Music theory facts (scales, chords, tunings, tempo names) are common knowledge.
tos.title: Before you start
tos.p1: The app is free and has no ads. Microphone sound is processed on the device only and is never sent anywhere.
tos.p2: Everything you add yourself — recordings, tabs, lyrics — stays on your device and is your responsibility. Only add things you have the rights to.

tabs.title: Tabs
tabs.hint: Use the arrow to reorder. At least one tab always stays. Open your profile with the button at the top of any tab.
track.title: Time tracking
track.hint.normal: With the screen off or the app in the background, time counts only while the metronome, a pad or audio is playing. Without sound in the background time stops and the stopwatch pauses.
track.hint.strict: Time runs only while the screen is on and the app is open. These hours are gold.
track.hint: The mode applies to new sessions and tools; recorded time doesn’t change. Stopwatch time is always normal.
track.strictTitle: Strict tracking: only with the screen on
gem.title: Mastery
gem.top: The highest level. From here the stone only shines brighter.
gem.hint: The gem grows only with practice in the app: within each step it gradually gets brighter. Diamond corresponds to the professional level — about 10,000 hours of practice.

me.hint: Experience before the app counts toward the rank and the total time, but not toward the mastery gem or weekly stats. Profile data is stored only on this device.
ob.intro: A few steps to set up the app: instruments, level, experience and a weekly goal.
ob.name: Name
ob.private: No account needed: all answers are stored on this device only and can be changed in the profile.
ob.instText: You can pick several. The tuner’s tuning depends on this.
ob.levelText: A rough estimate. For beginners the tuner and glider are set up more simply.
level.beginner.text: The first months of practice. The tuner shows the strings, the glider plays notes only.
level.amateur.text: The basics are familiar, playing for yourself.
level.pro.text: Music is the main occupation: performing, teaching, recording.
ob.expText: Roughly how many hours are already behind. They count toward the rank and the total time.
ob.goalText: Progress is counted by weeks: the total hours matter, not daily streaks.
ob.goalHint: The goal is suggested by level and can be changed at any time.

idle.watchTitle: The stopwatch is running. Is the practice still going?
idle.textQuiet: No sound and no actions for 10 minutes.
idle.wait: Without an answer within 5 minutes, tracking stops; time after the last action is not counted.
idle.ended: Session ended due to inactivity. Counted {d}, up to the last action.
idle.ended0: Session ended due to inactivity. Less than a minute was not counted.
idle.watchHidden: Stopwatch stopped: the app was in the background with no sound.
presence.title: Confirm playing by sound
presence.hint: The microphone measures only the loudness level: nothing is recorded and nothing leaves the device. After 10 minutes with no playing, no app sound and no actions, the session ends by itself without asking. Silent stretches longer than 5 minutes do not count toward the mastery gem.
presence.denied: No microphone access — confirming playing by sound is off.
presence.unavailable: Microphone unavailable — confirming playing by sound is off.
nosnd.mixer: Sound is off in the mixer: {bus}
rank.title: Rank
rank.prior: including {h} of experience before the app
rank.hint: The rank counts all experience: hours before the app plus practice in the app. Five ranks with three steps each; the dots at the bottom of the badge show the step.
idle.neverDone: Questions are off. Time without actions is not counted. They can be turned back on in Notifications.
notif.askIdle.hint: Appears after 10 minutes without sound or actions, or after 45 minutes without taps. Without an answer for 5 minutes, tracking stops. With the question off, tracking stops right away and time after the last action is not counted.
notif.noSoundNote.hint: Appears when something is playing but its sound is off in the mixer, or the device volume is zero or too low.
notif.rankNote.hint: One short message when a new rank step is reached.
